entities.summary: Tariq Luqmaan Trotter, better known by his stage name Black Thought, is an American rapper, singer, actor, television host, and the lead MC of the hip hop group The Roots, which he co-founded with drummer Questlove in Philadelphia. Regarded as "one of the most skilled, incisive, and prolific rappers of his time", he is widely lauded for his live performance skills, continuous multisyllabic rhyme schemes, complex lyricism, double entendres, and politically aware lyrics. He and The Roots perform as the house band for The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, frequently playing games with Fallon and his guests.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a lead MC of The Roots and house band for The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, Black Thought has had a significant impact on contemporary hip-hop and late-night television, influencing a generation of musicians and entertainers. His lyrical skill and socially conscious themes have made him a respected voice in the music industry.
